heightPolicy: A 32 m absolute datum and the original Terrarium field seat the model. The piazza portal starts at 33.7 m. The exposed garden-side base starts lower to follow the original grade. Foundations extend into native terrain and the court stays open.
limitations: Ordinary photographs and standard PMTiles determine the exterior and courtyard. Roof slopes, rear passage grades and decorative proportions are visual approximations.
The embassy interior and detached garden structures are outside the model. The front entrance is shown closed.
